purpose: Map seven-tuple extraction error classes (E1–E14, A–F, G1–G3) onto the NL-excerpt + LLM-executor path, and name error classes that only exist on the alternative path (N1–N11). Evidence from case 74 / 326 / 56 / 179 unless noted.

pipeline_loci.seven_tuple: formalization: quote → closed-set relation/polarity/modality/threshold. The model must commit. A wrong commitment is executable.
pipeline_loci.nl_excerpt: selection: passage → verbatim sentences + a disease name. No logical commitment. Errors are what got copied, to whom it was attached, and what the cap-40 ranker kept.
pipeline_loci.llm_executor: application: (findings, selected sentences) → ranking + supported/neutral/ruled_out. The commitment that the excerpt refused is reintroduced here, opaquely.

fate_of_extraction_classes.name: polarity inverted
fate_of_extraction_classes.note: No polarity slot, so the invert cannot be stored. Hedge/negation words stay in the sentence. The executor can still invert when applying (326 gold ruled_out despite 'or').

fate_of_extraction_classes.name: modality inflation
fate_of_extraction_classes.note: Modality stays as English. Executor may still treat 'usually must' as must if that sentence is shown; on 326 the Harrison usually-must sentence is unique#111 and never shown.

fate_of_extraction_classes.name: relation overclaim / false required_for A–F
fate_of_extraction_classes.note: 74 CPVT: 'Exercise testing is advised, but a negative test does not exclude…' is kept WHOLE at cap40 #18 — extract-side B-class is repaired. 326: 'Diagnose Brucellosis by blood or CSF cultures' is cap40 #1 (x6) — method-as-requirement is reintroduced as the most-repeated sentence, and gold is ruled_out 2/3.

fate_of_extraction_classes.name: this-variant deixis
fate_of_extraction_classes.note: disease field still has to name something; fuzzy subject_match still binds hypernyms.

fate_of_extraction_classes.name: empty predicate
fate_of_extraction_classes.note: Postprocess drops <6 words; table cells and headings still survive as 'sentences'.

fate_of_extraction_classes.name: mimic written as feature_of
fate_of_extraction_classes.note: The mimic sentence is copied. Executor may still read it as support rather than contrast; not gated.

fate_of_extraction_classes.name: and/or split into independent obligatory
fate_of_extraction_classes.seven_tuple: 326 bacteriologic AND serologic each required_for+obligatory; L1 kills gold
fate_of_extraction_classes.note: Harrison 'bacteriologic and/or serologic' survives as one sentence at unique rank #111 — outside cap 40 and even barely inside a 100-cap of 137 unique. The split cannot fire. A different method sentence occupies #1.

fate_of_extraction_classes.name: treatment as diagnostic
fate_of_extraction_classes.seven_tuple: ICD / HOCM 50 mmHg / aviation as required_for
fate_of_extraction_classes.note: use=treatment is labelled (LQTS cap40: 10/40 treatment). Support ranking still keeps them. Executor prompt does not drop them.

fate_of_extraction_classes.name: off-topic but locally faithful
fate_of_extraction_classes.seven_tuple: not a relation error; still binds and scores
fate_of_extraction_classes.note: Same passages, same off-topic sentences. Harm on NL is context cost; on seven-tuple it can still be a scored feature_of.

fate_of_extraction_classes.name: tautology / signifier as signified
fate_of_extraction_classes.seven_tuple: LQTS pathognomonic_for 'prolonged QT' from 'termed long QT syndrome' → L2 +2 confirmation, C0 gold rank 2
fate_of_extraction_classes.note: Definitional sentences still excerpted (LQTS cap40 #2 TdP, #12 'characteristic arrhythmia'). They cannot fire a +2 confirmation slot. C0's ranking inversion is gone. Residual harm is ranking noise, not a hard confirm.

fate_of_extraction_classes.name: argument swap
fate_of_extraction_classes.seven_tuple: sign as subject, disease as predicate
fate_of_extraction_classes.note: disease='ventricular tachycardia' bound onto CPVT candidate. 90/223 = 40% of CPVT-bound rules have a generic VT subject.

fate_of_extraction_classes.name: threshold hallucination
fate_of_extraction_classes.seven_tuple: quote lacks the number; threshold slot invents it
fate_of_extraction_classes.note: Threshold parsed only from the copied sentence. 216 non-verbatim spans already dropped. Cannot invent 440 ms on a sentence that does not contain it.

fate_of_extraction_classes.name: true necessity dual-slotted as pathognomonic
fate_of_extraction_classes.seven_tuple: Type I 'necessary for the diagnosis' also written pathognomonic_for; L2 over-confirms
fate_of_extraction_classes.note: The same sentence is Brugada cap40 #3, whole. Executor ruled Brugada out in 3/3 reps on absent Type-1 pattern. Dual-slot invention is impossible without slots.

fate_of_extraction_classes.name: cutoff encoded as excludes+negated
fate_of_extraction_classes.seven_tuple: 'normal QTc <440/460' never becomes required_for prolonged QTc; L1 cannot fire; 0 required_for carrying 440/460
fate_of_extraction_classes.note: Same sentence is LQTS cap40 #5 (x6), plus 'QTc >0.450 sec' at #11 with program-parsed threshold. Findings include QTc interval=380ms. Executor: LQTS neutral 2/3, supported 1/3, ruled_out 0/3. The clinical miss is identical; the broken module moved from encoding to application.

fate_of_extraction_classes.name: conjunction positive limb as feature_of
fate_of_extraction_classes.seven_tuple: CPVT consensus item 1 bidirectional VT all feature_of; structurally normal heart/normal ECG required_for
fate_of_extraction_classes.note: Consensus sentence exists verbatim in the unique set at support-rank #44 — outside cap40, inside cap100 (#44 and #47). Support ranking recreates the G3 miss: the positive limb is present in the corpus and absent from the prompt the executor sees.

fate_of_extraction_classes.name: converse not extracted
fate_of_extraction_classes.seven_tuple: 773 right-to-left as positive feature, no inverse
fate_of_extraction_classes.note: Excerpter copies the sentence that exists. It cannot invent the converse any more than the seven-tuple extractor can (without F5b).

new_classes_nl_only.name: support-rank burial
new_classes_nl_only.def: Decisive diagnostic sentences exist in the unique set but lose the cap-K contest to repeated treatment/etiology sentences.
new_classes_nl_only.evidence: CPVT consensus #44; 326 Harrison and/or #111; CPVT cap40 has 9 treatment of 40.

new_classes_nl_only.name: hypernym over-bind
new_classes_nl_only.def: subject_match attaches generic 'ventricular tachycardia' / 'polymorphic VT' rules onto a specific candidate.
new_classes_nl_only.evidence: 74 CPVT-bound 223 rules, 90 (40%) generic VT subject. Shared matcher with the mechanical engine, amplified because NL disease names are freer.

new_classes_nl_only.name: table-row as sentence
new_classes_nl_only.def: Chunked table cells copied as rules once the header is lost.
new_classes_nl_only.evidence: 39-sample 9/39; CPVT cap40 #31–32 Schwartz-style score rows for bidirectional VT.

new_classes_nl_only.name: dangling anaphora
new_classes_nl_only.def: A sentence-level excerpt loses the antecedent.

new_classes_nl_only.name: treatment crowding
new_classes_nl_only.def: use=treatment is labelled but not dropped; occupies cap slots.

new_classes_nl_only.name: executor under-firing of a recovered cutoff
new_classes_nl_only.def: The numeric rule AND the patient number are both in the prompt; the model does not mark ruled_out.
new_classes_nl_only.evidence: 74 LQTS: QTc 380 ms in findings, cutoff sentence #5, verdict never ruled_out. Asymmetry: Brugada (named-pattern absence) IS ruled_out 3/3.

new_classes_nl_only.name: executor over-firing / method-as-requirement
new_classes_nl_only.def: A workup sentence at high support is applied as a missing-test exclusion.
new_classes_nl_only.evidence: 326 gold ruled_out 2/3 on nl_rule; cap40 #1 is 'Diagnose by blood or CSF cultures'; finding is 'blood cultures grew a Gram-negative bacillus' (not named Brucella). none arm already ranks gold 9–11 and rules it out 1/3 — parametric SEA preference plus the culture sentence.

new_classes_nl_only.name: candidate-order sensitivity
new_classes_nl_only.def: Permutation of the candidate list changes the ranking more than withdrawing all rules.
new_classes_nl_only.evidence: §17.4 Kendall τ 0.33 shuffled vs 0.61 rules-vs-none. Mechanical engine is invariant to presentation order.

new_classes_nl_only.name: parametric override
new_classes_nl_only.def: The executor's prior already ranks a wrong disease first; retrieved rules do not displace it.
new_classes_nl_only.evidence: 56: none and nl_rule share top1 Undifferentiated Pleomorphic Sarcoma, gold rank 17 vs 19. 179: both arms top1 Pulmonary Atresia with VSD, gold rank 13 vs 11.

new_classes_nl_only.name: output truncation
new_classes_nl_only.def: JSON ranking truncated; unmentioned candidates keep presented-order tail.
new_classes_nl_only.evidence: cap100, case 773: n_ranked_by_model=0 after JSON cut mid-Eisenmenger sentence; gold_rank=1 because IPAH+PFO happened to be first in the shuffled presented order. (Earlier note said 522; that was the arm-level empty_answers misread.)

new_classes_nl_only.name: soft burial without elimination
new_classes_nl_only.def: Gold is ranked 8–19 with verdict neutral — not a layer-1 kill, a coverage/prior dump.
new_classes_nl_only.evidence: nl_rule gold rank>6: 56 (8–19), 179 (11–15), 475 (13), 326 (9–11). Mechanical median rank 3; these cases stay in mid-list even when extraction is wrong.

74_QTc_LQTS.clinical: QTc 380 ms should exclude congenital LQTS; CPVT should survive
74_QTc_LQTS.seven_tuple: G2 encodes the cutoff as excludes+negated (unexecutable); E12 tautology feeds L2 confirmation of LQTS. C0: LQTS top1, CPVT rank 2, gold NOT eliminated.
74_QTc_LQTS.nl: Cutoff sentence recovered at LQTS #5; QTc=380 ms in findings. Executor leaves LQTS neutral/supported. CPVT still ranks #1 because it is 'supported', not because LQTS was excluded. Brugada (absent Type-1) IS excluded.
74_QTc_LQTS.reading: NL 'wins' 74 by a different mechanism than F7. F7 stops a false L2 confirm. NL never fires the recovered exclusion either; it just does not award LQTS a pathognomonic bonus.

326_and_or.clinical: bacteriologic and/or serologic — missing TB serology must not kill Brucellosis
326_and_or.seven_tuple: E3+E9: two independent obligatory required_for. C0 gold eliminated, rank 12. C1+F7: not eliminated, rank 3.
326_and_or.nl: The and/or sentence is unique#111, not shown. Surface sentence is culture-method. Gold ruled_out 2/3, rank 9–11 — statistically the same dump as the none arm.
326_and_or.reading: The E9 split is gone. A method-as-requirement overclaim of class A is re-enacted at execution on a different sentence, on top of a parametric preference for spinal epidural abscess.

harm_polarity.seven_tuple: False POSITIVES of logical force: claiming necessity/sufficiency/exclusion the quote does not license. A single false obligatory required_for is a hard kill. Detectable by cue-vs-slot gates (F7). Repair is demotion.
harm_polarity.nl_extract: False NEGATIVES of logical force: refusing to claim anything. Residual extract errors (N1–N5) are mostly flooding. Detectable by verbatim check and use= filter. Repair is ranking/filtering, not demotion.
harm_polarity.nl_execute: Uncontrolled REINTRODUCTION of logical force: under-fire (N6) and over-fire (N7), order-sensitive (N8), prior-dominated (N9). Not detectable by string gates. No F7 analogue without a second NLI/threshold engine sitting on the executor.

brugada_named_pattern.rule_in_cap40: type I pattern necessary for the diagnosis (#3)

74_executor_asymmmetry.reading: The executor can apply a named-pattern absence. It does not reliably apply a numeric comparison even when both sides of the comparison are in the prompt. Mechanical layer-1 threshold_ok exists precisely for this case and was starved by G2; NL restores the inputs and still skips the comparison.
